message.content: Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles typically covers roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) along the I‑5 corridor. Under normal, non‑congested conditions you’d expect around **6 hours** of travel time. In practice, especially during peak commute periods or holiday weekends, traffic on the I‑5 can add several hours, so it’s wise to check a live navigation app before you head out.

We can provide approximate distance (~383 miles via I-5) and typical driving time (~6 hours).
